# Validate generalized translation-placement rule against demos
from collections import Counter

def candidate_transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=0)
    color=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    shape=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    minr,maxr=min(r for r,c in shape),max(r for r,c in shape)
    minc,maxc=min(c for r,c in shape),max(c for r,c in shape)
    for dr in range(-minr,h-maxr):
      for dc in range(-minc,w-maxc):
        pts=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in shape]
        if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r,c in pts):
          for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=color
    return out
print('demo2',candidate_transform(demo2_in)==demo2_out)
print('demo1',candidate_transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
